owner_request: Jag saknar ett hopp från sng/lifts sidan till quad

air_segments_of_interest.comment: void_u = drop of the floor under the flight below the lower endpoint (record_replay.air_segments); the trick jump crosses a 263 u void in two ~145 u flights via a mid ledge at z~100, total ~290 u at 460-476 u/s, no rocket (max rise 43.9 u per flight, plain-jump height)

rejection_investigation.what_the_59_were: route-lab registry 'sngspawn-to-quad' (SNG-tele spawns -> Quad), 59 candidates inside the 4.27 s gate, all rejected by human_paths.vet as 'gap'
rejection_investigation.method: refetched every rejected run's trajectory samples and measured the largest inter-sample position jump: dt, distance, endpoints, implied speed (full per-run table: evidence/sng_to_quad_gap_diagnostics.json)
rejection_investigation.verdict: ALL 59 ARE TRUE TELEPORTS, ZERO FALSE REJECTIONS

evidence.physics_bound: max plausible player speed ~900 u/s = ~12 u per 14 ms tick; the measured jumps are 25-67x over the bound

fixed_endpoint_pair.reading: every run's jump connects the same two points — the dm3 SNG teleporter entrance and its exit; a trick jump would scatter its endpoints and stay under ~12 u/tick

rejection_investigation.does_the_trick_jump_trip_the_gap_check: NO. The owner's demo peaks at 8.7 u/tick; the four clean corpus movement runs sample at ~20-72/s and their largest inter-sample steps stay far under the 220 u threshold. The vet filter was NOT loosened — no change was needed, globally or route-scoped.
rejection_investigation.conclusion_for_sngspawn_routes: sngspawn_a/b_to_quad remain teleport-dependent as recorded; their 4.27 s gate is a teleporter time and stays excluded from training

new_item_pair_cohort.envelope_leave_one_out: SATISFIED: 4 independent human movement runs >= 3 required
